description: This file contains a Kotlin class 'DeviceNotificationListenerService' that listens to notification events on an Android device, manages internal notification state, and provides external interfaces for querying and acting on notifications. It also includes related data classes, utility functions, and companion object methods for managing notification permissions and actions.

classes.name: DeviceNotificationEntry
classes.description: Data class representing a simplified notification entry with key details.

classes.name: DeviceNotificationSnapshot
classes.description: Data class representing the current snapshot of notifications including enabled status, connection state, and list of notifications.

classes.name: NotificationActionKind
classes.description: Enum class representing types of notification actions: Open, Dismiss, Reply.

classes.name: NotificationActionRequest
classes.description: Data class encapsulating a request to perform an action on a notification.

classes.name: NotificationActionResult
classes.description: Data class representing the result of an attempted notification action.

classes.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService
classes.description: Main service class that extends NotificationListenerService to monitor notifications and provides static helper methods and internal state management.

methods.name: sanitizeNotificationText
methods.description: Sanitizes and trims notification text to a maximum length.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationEntry.toJsonObject
methods.description: Serializes a DeviceNotificationEntry to a JSON object.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationStore.replace
methods.description: Replaces current notifications in the store with a new list.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationStore.upsert
methods.description: Inserts or updates a notification in the store.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationStore.remove
methods.description: Removes a notification from the store by key.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationStore.setConnected
methods.description: Updates the connection status and potentially clears notifications.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationStore.snapshot
methods.description: Returns a snapshot of current notification state.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService.onListenerConnected
methods.description: Handles logic when the notification listener service connects.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService.onListenerDisconnected
methods.description: Handles logic when the notification listener service disconnects.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService.onDestroy
methods.description: Handles cleanup on service destruction.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService.onNotificationPosted
methods.description: Handles a new notification posted event, updates store, and emits change event.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService.onNotificationRemoved
methods.description: Handles notification removal, updates store, and emits change event.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService.notificationChangedPayload
methods.description: Builds JSON payload describing notification change.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService.refreshActiveNotifications
methods.description: Refreshes internal store from current active notifications.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService.toEntry
methods.description: Converts a StatusBarNotification to a DeviceNotificationEntry.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService.serviceComponent
methods.description: Helper to get ComponentName for the service.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService.setNodeEventSink
methods.description: Sets callback sink for node events.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService.recentPackages
methods.description: Retrieves recent package names from shared preferences.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService.isAccessEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the notification listener permission is granted.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService.snapshot
methods.description: Returns current snapshot of notifications.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService.requestServiceRebind
methods.description: Requests the system to rebind the notification listener service.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService.executeAction
methods.description: Performs an action request on a notification.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService.executeActionInternal
methods.description: Internal method executing specific actions like open, dismiss, reply on a notification.
